label: RE
definition: 同时呈现冲突立场、利弊或一方面/另一方面的张力。

label: RE
definition: 重述压力、挫折、羞愧或不堪重负等主观体验。

label: RE
definition: 直接提出行动建议、警示后果或强调健康风险。

label: RE
definition: 通过确认式或开放式追问促使对方说明计划、原因或立场。

label: RES
definition: 重述对方表述并通过确认问题核对理解。
representative_evidence: F28269/s001: So, you're gonna quit then? || F29759/s007: So that means you want to quit now right || F8468/s002: and so because you were worried about them thinking that you were trying to avoid them you ended up using marijuana is that correct

definition: 提出行为建议、健康警示或直接评价可能后果。

label: REC
definition: 对经历、陈述或会谈内容进行重述、概括和理解核对。

label: REC
definition: 组织并呈现冲突目标、利弊或两面性。
representative_evidence: F20436/s001: okay so on one hand you feel like it would be a relief to be less stressed and overwhelmed about your schoolwork and then on the other hand you feel like you just don't have time to go to counseling because you have so much work to do || F10181/s001: so some of the negative things would be it's a impact on your health right the the smell clothes and so forth and then there's a lot of kind of social pushback || F12852/s002: okay so on one hand you feel like it would be a relief to be less stressed and overwhelmed about your schoolwork and then on the other hand you feel like you just don't have time to go to counseling because you have so much work to do

label: REC
definition: 概括情绪状态、困境或重要经历并表达理解。
representative_evidence: F22558/s001: Wow okay so it sounds like you're feeling pretty confident after our discussion || F16256/s003: and when you say it was scary I hear you saying on some level was scary for you and your your safety but it also sounds like it was scary because all these other variables or elements were put in motion that were disruptive || F26968/s002: okay so right now you have so much going on that you're just feeling totally overwhelmed you don't even know where to start

label: REC
definition: 提供建议、归纳行动计划或强调行为风险。
representative_evidence: F11405/s002: Well, you know, you're doing good but don't forget what we talked about today, okay, about your chew tobacco and your mouth || F9993/s001: it might be your decision if you want children but as a doctor I'm not prepared to make that decision and to verify that decision for you || F7054/s001: yeah absolutely if you don't have that first if you can stop yourself having that first drink you're more inclined not to keep drinking of course

label: QU
behavior_component: 开放式经历与观点探索
behavior_component_en: open exploration of experience and perspective
definition: 邀请对方展开经历、感受、观点或个人情境。
representative_evidence: F9959/s001: What kind of dog do you have? || F26485/s005: how do you feel about that || F21125/s001: okay so you said that you were a big runner what role did running play in your life

label: QU
definition: 询问改变的理由、利弊、障碍和可能行动，以促发自我反思。
representative_evidence: F27061/s001: do you know of any thing that will help you quit smoking? || F18310/s001: in what ways might your life be better if you succeed in making the changes you mentioned || F21203/s001: you also mentioned that smoking is a way to manage your weight and concern that if you are we're going to quit smoking what that would do in terms of gaining weight and that smoking after meals is pleasurable that it's something that would be really hard to give up

label: QU
behavior_component: 聚焦式事实与行为评估
definition: 收集病史、频率、数量、行为状态或其他相对明确的信息。
representative_evidence: F13430/s001: Did you come here for a prescription for anti-depressants? || F29590/s001: how long has it been since you kind of drink || F21935/s001: and you mentioned that you weren't sleeping too well do you have any weight changes during that time
boundary_note: 该成分混合开放和封闭问法，不能据此判断 QUO/QUC。

label: QUO
behavior_component: 开放式经历与观点探索
behavior_component_en: open exploration of experience and perspective
definition: 使用 what/how/tell me 等方式邀请对方展开经历、观点、目标和困难。
representative_evidence: F9959/s001: What kind of dog do you have? || F26485/s005: how do you feel about that || F24744/s001: um what do you think that there's more of more positive or negative
boundary_note: 开放形式并不自动等于治疗性功能。

label: QUO
definition: 探索改变的理由、障碍、两面性以及当前状态与目标的差距。
representative_evidence: F18310/s001: in what ways might your life be better if you succeed in making the changes you mentioned || F27061/s001: do you know of any thing that will help you quit smoking? || F21203/s001: you also mentioned that smoking is a way to manage your weight and concern that if you are we're going to quit smoking what that would do in terms of gaining weight and that smoking after meals is pleasurable that it's something that would be really hard to give up

label: QUO
behavior_component: 聚焦式数量与病史询问
definition: 询问数量、频率、时长、病史或具体行为状态。
representative_evidence: F13430/s001: Did you come here for a prescription for anti-depressants? || F29590/s001: how long has it been since you kind of drink
boundary_note: 该组与 QUO 标签口径不完全一致，作为标签内异质证据保留。

definition: 要求在数值量表上报告重要性、信心、准备度或其他主观状态。

label: QUC
behavior_component: 聚焦式健康与病史评估
definition: 通过较明确的问题收集健康、病史、物质使用、频率或当前行为信息。
representative_evidence: F21935/s001: and you mentioned that you weren't sleeping too well do you have any weight changes during that time || F13430/s001: Did you come here for a prescription for anti-depressants? || F14014/s003: Did you come here for a prescription for anti-depressants?
boundary_note: 部分问题可以产生长回答，不能只凭形式断言均为封闭问句。

label: QUC
definition: 征求讨论许可、询问方案接受度或让对方在选项间表达立场。

label: QUC
definition: 围绕理解、时长、感受或想法进行进一步澄清。

definition: 根据健康风险提出行为、治疗或生活方式建议。

label: SU

behavior_component: 行动、目标与个人优势肯定
behavior_component_en: affirmation of actions, goals, and strengths
definition: 正向评价对方的行动、计划、努力或个人优势。

label: AF
definition: 在重述对方计划或状态时加入鼓励和正向强化。

label: AF
definition: 通过感谢、赞赏参与或礼貌收尾维持互动关系。
